name: justsearch-mcp
description: A private retrieval backend for your AI agents — hybrid search and cited answers over your own files, with local indexing and inference.
long_description:
Connects this MCP client to the JustSearch desktop app's built-in MCP server. JustSearch indexes your local documents (PDF, email, Office, and most common formats) and answers questions over them with cited passages, using local indexing and inference — hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense vectors + learned-sparse + reranking) plus grounded Q&A.

Retrieved passages and file paths are returned to the MCP client you connect; a cloud-hosted client can forward them to its model provider. The desktop app checks for updates on launch when its build embeds a release URL (including CI-built branch candidates and pre-releases; no off switch yet). Install AI downloads models and runtimes from github.com and huggingface.co with consent. Trace export is off by default; enabling tracing and setting an OTLP endpoint sends traces there, potentially including paths and document excerpts.

**Requires the JustSearch desktop app (Windows or Linux) to be installed and running** — download it from https://github.com/justsearch-app/justsearch/releases. This bundle is only a thin, dependency-free stdio bridge to the app's loopback MCP endpoint (`http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp`); it makes no network connections beyond 127.0.0.1 and never downloads anything.

Five of the six tools are read-only. The one mutating tool, `justsearch_ingest` (adds files to the search index), is additionally gated behind an explicit approval prompt shown in the JustSearch app itself.

tools.name: justsearch_answer
tools.description: Read-only. RAG retrieval over the local index: assembled passages with per-source citations. Primary tool for answering questions about indexed content.

tools.name: justsearch_search
tools.description: Read-only. Exploratory hybrid search (keyword + dense + learned-sparse, reranked) with facets and filters, for discovery and browsing.

tools.name: justsearch_browse
tools.description: Read-only. Explore the folder structure of indexed locations.

tools.name: justsearch_ingest
tools.description: MUTATING — adds files/folders to the search index. Not read-only. Gated behind an approval prompt in the JustSearch app: the call returns immediately and a human approves (or denies) in the app window.

tools.name: justsearch_status
tools.description: Read-only. Index health: document count, enrichment coverage, readiness.

tools.name: justsearch_runtime_manifest
tools.description: Read-only. Redacted runtime manifest (identity, lifecycle, AI runtime state) for identity-aware caching.
